title: Noire - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Noire in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Absorbs Dark and is weak to Light, the mirror of Clair.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight
ResistsNone
AbsorbsDark
ImmuneNone

Bring Light damage. Dark is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Noire
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Dark, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
